definition: taking air in and letting it out
description: In clear blue sea, a young woman with long dark hair, in a blue bikini top, black board shorts and fins, floats upright beside a rope with a weight hanging from it and slowly blows a long stream of silver bubbles from her mouth that rise toward the bright rippling surface. Her eyes close, her fins move gently and she brings one hand to her chest. A single fish swims past on the right, and a pale sandy seabed lies below her in the deep blue water.

de.answer: Sie stößt einen Strom von Luftblasen aus.
